stories.headline: London police recover 893 kg of cocaine hidden among oranges, with eight held and about £450,000 in cash found
stories.body: On the evening of 22 November the Metropolitan Police made arrests at New Spitalfields Market in Leyton, where about 100 kg of cocaine was found, and a lorry stopped near Maidstone and searched at Dover yielded roughly 250 kg more. The total reached 893 kg, and a Cheshunt, Hertfordshire property produced around £450,000 in cash. Eight people remain in custody in a probe into an organised group smuggling class A drugs into the UK.
